assessment_scope: Complete current primary plan docs/plans/2026-09-14-cleanup-integration-and-commit.md, INTEGRATE-1 and TG-INTEGRATED, against approved design-review-cleanup-delivered-package and delivered-scope. Prospective integration and closeout only; no reconstruction of earlier gate history. Technical renewal: unchanged earlier scope is retained after identity comparison; the revised Validation section and integration plan are independently read in full affected context. Previous judgments remain on their original identities.
independence_basis: Independent delegated reviewer authored neither the integration plan nor its engineering inputs. Design review was independently performed; this separate judgment assesses sequencing and verification allocation, not implementation.
limitations: Approval establishes plan adequacy, not that implementation, tests, final Code Review, Verify, backup recovery or commit checks have succeeded. Canonical code-review-cleanup-consolidation-first / cleanup-supporting-evidence-selection remains open until independently resolved.
No adoption of remaining VAL-SR-23, DIST-SR-21/22, REL-SR-25 or unrelated historical source/fixture cleanup. Material scope, Design, plan or verification changes require reassessment.

The earlier assumption that inspect alone validates complete reference closure is superseded by this correction. This is technical Design/Delivery approval only; implementation and regression outcomes remain for independent Code Review and final Verify.
rationale: The milestone freezes additional cleanup, names actual accumulated diff including required untracked evidence, preserves prior plans as history and excludes deferred adoption. Fresh Design and Delivery gates precede the material selector correction; final whole-change Code Review follows all corrections and distinct Verify follows that review.

TG-INTEGRATED covers the concrete selector failure and adversarial boundaries: explicit support add/change/delete, unknown/mixed paths, unregistered reserved paths, malformed stores and escaping links, with current proof retained and no historical record mutation. Tests must exercise current v3 safety; historical rejection means retained existing proof, not revival of retired v2 protocol tests.

Complete selected validation plus broad smoke cover cross-batch consumer interactions; combined local --broad-smoke execution is explicitly allowed with existing deduplication and actual check population retained. Release transaction proof is required unless already covered, followed by record/diff/provenance, README/index and post-commit byte checks. Failures require owner corrections and reruns, not weakened gates.

One coherent checkpoint is justified by shared model/selector/evidence dependencies; the plan rejects broken intermediate commits or fabricated records. Complete pre-integration backup plus Git recovery, preserving unrelated work and source stability during release checks, gives a bounded recovery path. Local PR material is permitted; no push, publication or external handoff is inferred.

Code review correctly identified that record-store inspect validates individual records but does not establish cross-record reference closure. Existing validate-record-store.mjs already calls the stored format set validator over the captured files. The revised Design requires bounded Subject-path output only from that same validated in-memory snapshot, eliminating the incorrect mechanism assumption without a second reader/schema or authority promotion. Reserved/unknown/unsafe support paths remain blocked; normal and revision validation behavior remain unchanged; mixed/unknown options reject.

INTEGRATE-1 now explicitly allocates dangling EntryRef and unknown/mixed validator option regressions in addition to existing support membership boundaries, full selected+broad checks and distinct final Code Review/Verify. The changed technical basis is design-review-cleanup-delivered-package-complete-set. No scope expansion or removal of prior coverage; correction follows these renewed gates.
summary: Approved exact renewed delivery basis for complete-set validation before same-snapshot supporting Subject selection.
